title: Wall Angels: You're Wrong
style: Beautiful hand-drawn chalk illustration on a dark green school chalkboard, clean plain background, soft chalk dust texture, consistent portrait 2:3 framing, no text inside generated images.
character: Same 20-year-old adult character in every slide: athletic but approachable build, fully clothed in a simple light chalk-white tank top, mid-thigh shorts, socks, short tied-back hair, friendly expressive face.
voice: Upbeat, friendly, brisk delivery with clear word-by-word subtitle timing.

exercises.name: WALL ANGELS
exercises.a: Portrait 2:3 chalk drawing on a dark green school chalkboard, same 20-year-old adult character centered with generous margins, top 18% of image completely empty, whole body visible, no text, letters, or numbers. Full-body side view, character standing with back against a simple chalk-outlined wall plane, feet flat on the floor hip-width, heels about six inches from the wall, knees softly straight. Butt and upper back touch the wall, but the lower back is strongly arched away from the wall with a clearly visible large gap, ribs flared forward, chin poked forward. Arms are in a wall-angel goalpost: upper arms out to the sides at shoulder height, elbows bent 90 degrees, backs of hands trying to touch the wall, shoulders shrugged up toward ears. Same camera angle and framing as pose b, chalk texture, plain clean background.
exercises.b: Portrait 2:3 chalk drawing on a dark green school chalkboard, same 20-year-old adult character centered with generous margins, top 18% of image completely empty, whole body visible, no text, letters, or numbers. Full-body side view, character standing with back against the same simple chalk-outlined wall plane, feet flat on the floor hip-width, heels about six inches from the wall, knees softly straight. Butt, upper back, and back of head align with the wall, ribs tucked down, pelvis neutral, lower back gently close to the wall with only a small natural space. Arms are in the same wall-angel goalpost position: upper arms out to the sides at shoulder height, elbows bent 90 degrees, forearms vertical, wrists near the wall, shoulders relaxed down away from ears. Same camera angle and framing as pose a, chalk texture, plain clean background.

exercises.name: CHIN TUCKS
exercises.a: Portrait 2:3 chalk drawing on a dark green school chalkboard, same 20-year-old adult character centered with generous margins, top 18% of image completely empty, whole body visible, no text, letters, or numbers. Full-body side view against a simple chalk-outlined wall plane, feet flat on the floor hip-width, heels four inches from the wall, knees softly straight, butt and shoulder blades touching the wall, arms relaxed by the sides with palms facing thighs. Start of a wall chin tuck: chin level, neck long, head slightly forward so the back of the skull is visibly away from the wall by a few inches, eyes looking straight ahead. Same camera angle and framing as pose b, chalk texture, plain clean background.
exercises.b: Portrait 2:3 chalk drawing on a dark green school chalkboard, same 20-year-old adult character centered with generous margins, top 18% of image completely empty, whole body visible, no text, letters, or numbers. Full-body side view against the same simple chalk-outlined wall plane, feet flat on the floor hip-width, heels four inches from the wall, knees softly straight, butt and shoulder blades touching the wall, arms relaxed by the sides with palms facing thighs. End of the wall chin tuck: head glides straight backward until the back of the skull gently touches the wall, chin pulled slightly in like making a soft double chin, neck tall, eyes still level, shoulders relaxed. Same camera angle and framing as pose a, chalk texture, plain clean background.

result: Portrait 2:3 chalk drawing on a dark green school chalkboard, same 20-year-old adult character centered with generous margins, top 18% of image completely empty, whole body visible, no text, letters, or numbers. Character stands tall and relaxed facing slightly three-quarter toward camera, feet flat hip-width on the floor, knees soft, pelvis neutral, ribs stacked over hips, shoulders open and down, neck long, chin level, arms relaxed at sides. Proud happy smile, confident calm posture, clean plain chalkboard background, beautiful chalk texture.

lines.hook: Most people arch their low back and miss the stretch.
lines.ex1: Tuck ribs down, zip your belly, then slide your arms.
lines.ex2: Chin tucks stack your head over your shoulders fast.
lines.takeaway: Two minutes daily helps you stand taller and looser.
